content_zh:
“这谜题的给出略显明确啊。”封不觉径直走到那个保险向前，蹲下后仔细查看起来，“嗯……毕竟是训练模式，而且可能考虑到了玩家在恐惧中无法冷静思考的因素吧。”他的话貌似是嫌难度太低的意思……
王叹之也跟了进来，此刻他只觉得这些墙上画着的人脸栩栩如生，甚至找不到任意两张雷同的，这屋子里仿佛真有上百双眼睛盯着自己在看一般，令人毛骨悚然。
“觉哥，咱们把箱子搬出去再研究怎样？”王叹之道。
“最多三分钟就好。”封不觉很快又站了起来，拿出那六张人脸素描，举在近前，开始观看墙上那些人脸，“凑近看那保险箱，就会有系统提示，让我输入六位的数字密码来开启。”他的视线很快就停下，“嗯……在那儿。”他走到一面墙边，向左侧歪着头，“这屋里画了大量的人脸，只是为了扰乱玩家的视线。”他指着那面墙，“瞧，连续的六张面孔，斜着排成一线，而且正是素描上画的那六张，长相一致。”他逐一对比着那些难以直视的恐怖人脸，从左到右，从上到下，按照墙上那六张脸的顺序，配上素描纸角上的数字，轻声念道，“四、一、六、三、五、二。”
封不觉说着，又回到保险箱旁，开始输入密码：“如果探索第一个房间时只是当脸，“其实答案就摆在门开启时光线最亮的那块区域，但没有素描的提示，即便知道这六位数的密码得在本房间里寻找也得不到这些数字。”
这时，保险箱还真就被“失算了。”封不觉看完这两件东西的属性后立即道。
“怎么了？”王叹之似乎被他的从容所感染，这时已冷静了许多，惊吓值又回到了3%上下。
“钥匙应该很快就会用到，不过这个……”封不觉把卡片交给了王叹之。
【名称：爆炸神拳】
【技能卡属性：主动技能，使用两次后消失】
【技能类别：格斗】
【效果：击中目标后产生爆炸，造成火属性伤害】
【消耗：体能值50】
【学习条件：格斗专精F】
【备注：BOOM！】
“我本来以为奖励会是装备的，结果是个技能。”封不觉道。
“呃……先不说装备还是技能的问题，觉哥你怎么知道会有奖励的？”王叹之问道。
“很明显不是吗？虽然这个模式除了经验值以外什么额外奖励都不给，但为保证游戏性，剧本依然提供给了玩家两种通关方法。”封不觉解释道，“我们现在正在走解谜路线，而不是暴力冲杀。”他把钥匙拿在手里，带着王叹之走出了第二个房间。
“走非解谜路线的玩家，只要克服恐惧，冷静应敌，有效率地进行战斗，就能获得专精等级的提升，随着人物等级的提高，战斗技能和方式的增多，他们在战斗中便也可以获得技巧值了。
而我们这种游戏方式，更侧重于提升整体的游戏效率，而非单纯提升战斗效率。通过解谜可以降低通关难度，减少战斗的比重，更多地掌握剧本的情况。但这样玩的人在专精等级上会有所落后，系统自然会有其他方面的补偿，一般来说，应该是更多的技巧值。”

王叹之听到这儿明白了，接着他的话道：“但训练模式没有技巧值可以拿……所以玩家选择解谜的话，就会在剧本当中直接获得物品作为一种弥补。”
“正确。”封不觉试了试第三个房间的门，和他预料的一样，门是锁着的，他随即就用手里的钥匙去开，果然吻合，门开启后钥匙也就消失了。
第三个房间里很干净，靠着墙边的地方，放着一张书桌，桌上放着一本笔记本。
“对了，你的专精等级开了几个？”封不觉拿起笔记本时问道。
“我的格斗和通用都是F，觉哥你呢？”
“我只开启了通用。”封不觉已翻开笔记本看了起来，“你的格斗专精是在什么情况下开启的？”

"The puzzle is a little clear." Feng Bujue walked straight to the safety, squatted down and looked at it carefully, "Well... it is a training mode after all, and it may have taken into account the fact that players cannot think calmly when they are afraid." His words seemed to mean that the difficulty was too low...
Wang Tanzhi also followed in. At this moment, he only felt that the faces painted on the walls were so lifelike that he couldn't even find any two that were the same. It was as if there were hundreds of pairs of eyes staring at him in the room, which was creepy.
"Brother Jue, how about we move the box out and study it later?" Wang Tanzhi said.
"Just three minutes at most." Feng Bujue quickly stood up again, took out the six face sketches, held them close, and began to look at the faces on the wall, "Look closer at the safe, and there will be a system prompt asking me to enter a six-digit password to open it." His gaze quickly stopped, "Well... there." He walked to a wall and tilted his head to the left, "There are a lot of faces painted in this room. Just to disturb the player's sight." He pointed at the wall, "Look, six consecutive faces are lined up diagonally, and they are exactly the same as the six faces drawn in the sketch." He compared the scary faces one by one, from left to right, from top to bottom, in the order of the six faces on the wall, and said softly, "Four, one, six, three, five, two."
Feng Bujue said, returned to the safe, and began to enter the password: "If you were just cheating when you explored the first room," in fact, the answer is in the area with the brightest light when the door is opened, but there is no sketch prompt. Even if you know the six-digit password, you have to search for it in this room. You can't get these numbers. "
At this time, the safe was really "miscalculated." "Feng Bujue said immediately after reading the attributes of these two things.
"What's wrong? "Wang Tanzhi seemed to be infected by his calmness. He had calmed down a lot by now, and his fright level returned to around 3%.
"The key should be needed soon, but this..." Feng Bujue handed the card to Wang Tanzhi.

[Skill card attribute: active skill, disappears after being used twice]
[Skill Category: Fighting]
[Effect: After hitting the target, an explosion will occur, causing fire damage]
[Consumption: Physical energy value 50]
[Learning conditions: Fighting Specialization F]

“I originally thought the reward would be equipment, but it turned out to be a skill. "Feng Bujue said.
"Uh... let's not talk about equipment or skills. Brother Jue, how do you know there will be rewards? Wang Tanzhi asked.
"It's obvious isn't it? Although this mode does not give any additional rewards except experience points, in order to ensure the gameplay, the script still provides players with two ways to pass the level. "Feng Bujue explained, "We are now taking the route of solving puzzles, rather than violently killing. "He took the key in his hand and led Wang Tanzhi out of the second room.
“Players who take the non-puzzle route can gain an upgrade in their specialization level as long as they overcome fear, respond calmly to the enemy, and fight efficiently. As their character level increases and combat skills and methods increase, they can also gain skill points in combat.
Our game style is more focused on improving the overall game efficiency, rather than simply improving combat efficiency. By solving puzzles, you can reduce the level of difficulty, reduce the proportion of combat, and gain more control over the scenario. But people who play this way will lag behind in terms of expertise level, and the system will naturally provide compensation in other aspects. Generally speaking, it should be more skill points. "
Wang Tanzhi understood when he heard this, and continued: "But there are no skill points to get in the training mode... So if the player chooses to solve the puzzle, he will get items directly in the script as a kind of compensation. "
"correct. "Can't seal it?"Jue tried the door of the third room. As he expected, the door was locked. He immediately used the key in his hand to open it. Sure enough, the key disappeared after the door was opened.
The third room was very clean. There was a desk against the wall with a notebook on it.
"By the way, what's your specialization level?" Feng Bujue asked as he picked up his notebook.
"My fighting and general skills are both F, how about you, Brother Jue?"
"I only turned on general." Feng Bujue opened his notebook and started reading, "Under what circumstances did you turn on your fighting specialization?"
